title: Sportswear HO19 / Zoom 2K portrait layout

location.series: Annie Nguyen / Nike Sportswear Core Holiday 2019

slide_intent: Keep a recognizable composition across format changes so viewers can connect separate campaign encounters.
strategic_value: The same taped-frame language can link this vertical Zoom 2K artwork with the wide campaign image.
demonstration: A central photograph shows hands adjusting a black shoe with lime laces; a taped pale frame and product name sit over urban imagery, above the lower headline.
practical_value: Compare this vertical hierarchy with NS01 to see what is retained and what is rearranged.

content_islands.name: Framed action
content_islands.spec: Make the hands and shoe the main view inside the taped frame, with the product name on its lower margin.

content_islands.name: Urban collage
content_islands.spec: Use teal texture, architecture and smaller wearer images behind the frame.

content_islands.name: Lower message
content_islands.spec: Center a white headline, smaller supporting line and Nike signature below the frame.

reference_purposes.Expression: A central photograph shows hands adjusting a black shoe with lime laces; a taped pale frame and product name sit over urban imagery, above the lower headline.
